summary: Iter7 — full backend + frontend coverage of the 4 new modules: Estate CRUD, Goal.linked_asset_ids, Advisor Alerts Feed, Client PDF Report. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_estate_goals.py — TestEstate (advisor requires household_id -> 400; create beneficiary+document, update allocation, delete both; enterprise 403 on write) + TestGoalLinked (POST /goals with linked_asset_ids persists on create, round-trips on GET, PUT updates list, PUT can clear to empty). Frontend verified via Playwright against the public preview URL as advisor@compass.ca with client_a1 active, drilling after a feed-item click (navigated to Okafor household). (1) /dashboard renders advisor-alerts-feed with 8 feed-item-* rows, worst-score first (first row = Okafor score 55 'No retirement projection on file / Build a retirement projection'); clicking a row navigates to /profile with that household active. (2) /tax has 6th tab-estate; Estate tab shows estate-value, estate-registered (read-only) and estate-total ($85,662 ON). Province select change ON->QC recomputed estate-total to $110,982 (reactive). add-estate-button opens estate-modal; default kind=beneficiary -> added TEST_RRSP/TEST_Spouse/50% appeared in beneficiary-register; switching field-kind to document -> added TEST_Will appeared in document-register; edit (click row Edit) updated allocation 50->77 in register; delete (confirm dialog) removed the row. (3) /goals shows an edit-goal-<id> button per goal; clicking opens goal-modal with Fund-from-accounts checklist (2 link-<id> sources from Net Worth). Pre-link goal-current was editable; after checking first source goal-current became disabled with value 202,706 (sum of linked balances); on goal-save the goal card showed goal-linked-<id> badge 'Auto-funded · 1 source'. (4) /report renders report-preview with Net worth / Protection score / Retirement success / balance sheet / top goals; clicking download-report triggered a real PDF download 'The-Okafor-Household-summary.pdf' with no JS console errors from jsPDF.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' fires when opening the goal modal — f.current_amount starts undefined then becomes a number. Harmless but should initialise state with ({title:'', target_amount:'', current_amount:0, target_year: ..., linked_asset_ids: []}) in the modal.

action_items: (Low) Initialise goal-modal form state fully so React does not warn about an uncontrolled->controlled input on first open.
critical_code_review_comments: Tax.jsx Estate component: delete uses window.confirm() dialog (works but blocks Playwright unless dialog handler is set) — consider an in-app confirm toast for parity with other registers.
Goals.jsx GoalModal: form state defaults rely on spread of g which may be undefined for new goals; coerce current_amount/target_amount to numbers or '' to avoid React uncontrolled warning.
ClientReport.jsx: jsPDF generation is synchronous on main thread — fine for a one-pager but should be moved to a web worker or chunked if sections grow.
Dashboard advisor-alerts-feed: scoring/ordering mirrors AdvisorClients; good reuse but the empty-state message selector is not data-testid'd — add e.g. 'advisor-alerts-empty' for QA assertions.
server.py plan_profile_save still accepts advisor without household_id (flagged in iter6) — unchanged.
